headline: Odisha Secures 18 Investment Deals Worth ₹1.17 Lakh Crore in Power Push
summary: The Indian state of Odisha signed 18 memoranda of understanding securing investment commitments worth ₹1.17 lakh crore to add 11,742 MW of electricity generation capacity.
why: Industrial and power infrastructure buildouts in mineral-rich Indian states drive domestic capital goods and power utility equity performance.
